England Dominates Croatia 7-0 in Nations League Match

England secured a decisive 7-0 victory over Croatia in a UEFA Nations League match on October 3rd. Harry Kane and Bukayo Saka each scored two goals, while Jude Bellingham contributed one goal and three assists. Anthony Gordon and Morgan Rogers also scored for England in the match played in Rijeka. The coverage also noted that the stadium could be nearly full despite a UEFA ban.
